actions.explain: Upload a PO for Spark to read, or type a new order in by hand.

empty.title: Nothing needs you right now
empty.description: New tasks appear here as soon as an order reaches your step.

kind.SEND_PI: Send the PI to the customer

records.default: Records that this is done. OrderPilot sends nothing.
records.RAISE_SPR: Raises the SPR for approval. OrderPilot buys nothing.
records.CONFIRM_PAYMENT: Opens the form for the amount, the bank reference and the date.

next.PACK_ORDER: Support makes the invoice and packing list next.
next.ADD_SHIPPING_DOCUMENTS: That was the order's last step.

timeline.title: My timeline
timeline.intro: What you finished, what you are on, and what comes next.
timeline.summaryNone: Nothing is waiting, so there is nothing to clear.

done.empty: Nothing marked done here yet today.

now.title: Now
now.pastUsual: Past the usual time for this step

next.title: Next
next.empty: No more tasks are queued behind this one.

flows.title: Orders in each step
flows.summary: {{count}} open sales orders. The busiest step is {{step}}.

rules.emptyDescription: Every business rule has been confirmed by Spectra.

signin.lead: One place for every order, from the customer's PO to the goods leaving.

read.title: AI reads
read.body: It reads each document and picks out the customer, items, quantities and prices.

decide.title: Rules decide
decide.body: Fixed rules compare quantities, prices and PO references across the documents, and check stock.

approve.title: People approve
approve.body: The right person confirms anything uncertain. Business Central stays the system of record.
